user: Can I dispute that charge? State the applicable reason code and filing window in days; do not file anything.
answer:
Yes, TX-0401 is eligible for a dispute under reason code **`goods_not_received`**. I have not filed anything.

- **Filing window:** 90 days from the transaction date (2026-07-20).
- **Deadline:** 2026-10-18. As of today (2026-09-15), the window is open.
- **Eligibility checks:** reason code, transaction status, window, and compliance hold all passed.

fragments.text:
Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Limit operations
## Window definition
Limits are tracked on calendar days, not business days. The daily window runs
from 00:00 to 23:59 CET.

Glossary
## Chargeback window
The number of days, counted from the transaction date, during which a dispute
may be raised under a given reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.
